direct-answer.description: Use for simple answers or session continuation when no larger workflow package is needed.
direct-answer.expected_output: A concise answer or session update grounded in the broker event and bounded session context.

coding.description: Use for implementation, bug fixing, deployment, repo workflow, and verification requests.
coding.expected_output: A narrow implementation unit with focused verification, a Conventional Commit, and deploy attempt or recorded blocker.

qa.description: Use for testing, validation, smoke checks, regressions, and runtime QA requests.
qa.expected_output: A pass/fail verification report with commands, observed behavior, and blockers.
verification: cd browser_extension && npm run verify && npm run smoke

landscape-research.description: Use for broad research, comparison, online search, prior art, market, and optimal-path questions.
landscape-research.expected_output: A sourced research report, comparison, recommendation, and implementation implications.
verification: record sources and search queries in reference/scratch/landscape-research
link findings back to an OpenSpec change or tracked ticket

design.description: Use for frontend, visual design, interaction model, and UX QA requests.
design.expected_output: A working UI change verified with screenshots or text/layout checks.
verification: run the target surface verify command
capture before/after screenshots when a browser or app surface changes

writing.description: Use for writing, editing, copy, posts, emails, docs, and voice/style work.
writing.expected_output: A concise draft or critique that preserves the user's intent and stores any durable product decision in repo files.
